step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an automated synthetic monitoring solution. Internal stakeholders access a status page hosted on AWS Amplify. Amplify queries AWS AppSync GraphQL API, which triggers a Lambda function to fetch status, historical runs, and alert data from CloudWatch. CloudWatch executes canaries scheduled by a Time Trigger (EventBridge) and writes test artifacts (HAR files, screenshots) to Amazon S3.
